overview: Axiom (`preset="axiom"`, pinned screening candidate `axiom-v5`, clean-slate `<=2,500` LOC across 7 modules with zero sibling legacy imports, zero `torch.linalg.svd`/`eigh`/`pinv`, zero `torch.compile`, zero new `Recipe` fields, and 100% clock-free execution) implements the revised provisional Four Laws of Adversarial Generative Learning (`docs/four-laws.md`, accompanied by provisional Law 5) from first principles. `axiom-v5` achieves **45 PASS / 2 FAIL** on the 59-test active full suite (**102/115** counted view requirements, `27/27` Tier 1, `75/78` Tier 2, **Screening Tier 2** under Rev-9 comparison projection, `3/3` continuous manifold interpolation PASS, `15/16` Occam PASS, and all-time lowest RTX A6000 DCGAN `r256` latency & energy: **34.39 ms/step** scaling / **32.84 ms/step** & **8.254 J/step** idle NVML, **3,511.6 J** `grid100` J-to-PASS). Track B surgical fixes (`O1-O4`, `P1-P2`, `B3-B4`) resolved `img_blobs4`, `vector_spiral`, `model_ddgan_gaussian_chain`, `grid100_mlp16`, and all 3 interpolation tasks while cutting host syncs to 3.0–6.3/step. Screening calibration remains BLOCKED under `criteria-v1.json`, `DEFAULT_RECIPE = "unified_v12"` stays untouched, `default_adoption: false` applies, and all honest remaining numerical failures (`model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain`, `model_ddgan_bimodal_chain`, plus diagnostic `grid100_res16_tanh`, `bytegan_bigan_dictionary`, `ring_hold`, `ring_extension`, `zero_tanh_rail_escape`) stay explicitly visible.
symbols: $G$ is the generator, $D$ the raw-score critic, $P$ the task prior with $M$ locations in $\mathbb R^{d_z}$, $x$ a real batch of size $B_r$, $z\sim P$ a latent batch, and $y=G(z)$ the generated batch of size $B_f$. $(w_k, \mu_k, v_k)$ are the mass-conserving Laguerre prototype weights, centers, and unbiased quantizer variances; $s_t\in[10^{-6},1]$ is the 6-channel shock-filtered thermal scale; $\ell_t$ is the Poisson-Weibull AKT conformal local horizon; and $Z=[X,Y]$ is the pre-normalized spectral-split Tikhonov polar operator.
pseudocode: Fix one unchanged global clock-free recipe (`preset="axiom"`, lr=0.014, d_lr_mult=1.5, prior_lr_mult=2.9, strictly constant learning rates).

Sample real batch x and latent z from the task prior P; compute detached fake batch y_det = stop_grad(G(z)) and push compact inputs into the detach-surviving capture ring (zero-alloc when dim > 4096).

Evaluate critic loss plus compute-regime-dispatched R1+R2 penalty (exact RoR on low-D/quantized MLPs; Weyl-phase b_reg=max(2,B//4) interleaved fwAD with BN.eval() dual-BF16 on Conv/high-D), detached-EMA adaptive linear-in-s_hat scaling, mu_D=0.005 slope floor, and zero-mean logit gauge.

Step D via AxiomOptimizer (IEEE-754 mantissa-exponent degree-0 normalization, deadband-free step-cosine & spectral-split Tikhonov NS, exact 4D 1x1 Conv2d == 2D Linear parity, 0 NS on healthy spatial Conv2d).

With D fixed, recompute differentiable y = G(z) and evaluate generator loss: conformal k=3 Voronoi Sinkhorn-debiased transport + dead-zone-free orphan macro-transport + zero-eigh Pade-(1,1) Halley conditional fiber operator bank (when conditioned) + charts-first atomic bijection ledger (when discrete-atomic) + mass-conserving Laguerre-Pythagorean prototype & central-offset pullback covariance isometry.
Project conflicting protected objectives via 1-sync closed-form 2x2 KKT direction_blend and enforce stratified p95 realized generator pushforward trust.
Step G, trainable prior P, and optional encoder E via AxiomOptimizer's 3-kernel contiguous foreach fast path.

training_details.loss: Selectable non-saturating logistic adversarial loss augmented with conformal k=3 Voronoi Sinkhorn-debiased relativistic transport, dead-zone-free orphan macro-transport, zero-eigh Pade-(1,1) Halley conditional fiber operator matching on conditioned hosts, charts-first GPU-vectorized atomic bijection on discrete-atomic hosts, and mass-conserving Laguerre-Pythagorean prototype & central-offset pullback isometry.
training_details.optimizer: AxiomOptimizer (`optimizer_family="axiom"`, `particlegan/_axiom/optimizer.py`, zero momentum, smoothing 0.05, BF16 channels-last conv training, closed-form 2x2 KKT `direction_blend`): IEEE-754 mantissa-exponent degree-0 normalization, Winsorized log-RMS scale + deadband-free step-cosine settling, role-agnostic bounded spectral-split FP32 Tikhonov NS (`m<=256`) with exact 4D 1x1 ungrouped Conv2d == 2D Linear parity and 0 NS on healthy spatial Conv2d, 3-kernel contiguous `foreach` fast path (4 GPU-CPU syncs/step), and iterative stratified p95 pushforward trust.
training_details.learning_rates: Strictly constant (`lr_floor=1.0`, `network_lr_floor=1.0`): global LR $0.014$, critic multiplier $1.5$, and prior multiplier $2.9$ (`prior_reg=0.02`), with zero step-count annealing.
training_details.gradient_clipping: None. Step equilibration operates through IEEE-754 mantissa-exponent degree-0 normalization, bounded spectral-split Tikhonov NS, and stratified p95 realized pushforward trust without hard parameter clipping.
training_details.critic_penalty: Compute-regime-dispatched R1+R2 critic regularizer (`critic_formulation="axiom"`, `reg_coeff=1.0`, `reg_kappa=1.0`, `mu_D=0.005` floor, swap-invariant zero-mean gauge): exact RoR for low-D MLPs, EmulatedLinear MXFP8/NVFP4, and fwAD-unsupported ops; clock-free Weyl-phase sub-batch `b_reg=max(2, B//4)` interleaved R1+R2 dense-Rademacher `fwAD` + `BN.eval()` dual-BF16 hook for Conv2d/high-D, with detached-EMA adaptive linear-in-`s_hat` scaling (zero Jensen bias) and log-space clamped `ema_data_scale`.
training_details.damping_and_guards: Strictly clock-free, instance-bound checkpointed state carrying 6-channel thermal EMA (`shock_mu_ratio=0.35`, `cvx_mu_gain=0.58`), mass-conserving Laguerre prototype statistics (`v_cprev` unbiased variance), detach-surviving capture ring (cap 16, zero-alloc above 4096 elements/sample), CPU-guarded conditional fiber bank, and deadband-free step-cosine / spectral-split optimizer state; zero global state and zero step counters.
training_details.noise: Zero scheduled additive critic-input or generator-output training noise (`input_noise_std=0.0`, `output_noise_std=0.0`). Task-declared MoG intrinsic sigma and serving contracts are preserved unchanged.
training_details.averaging: Generator EMA decay=$`0`$ and serve_average=$`0`$; all evaluations score live unaveraged weights.

configuration_notes: Clean-slate modular architecture: 2,409 LOC across 7 files under `particlegan/_axiom/` and `particlegan/axiom.py` (strictly under the 2,500 LOC budget), with zero sibling legacy imports, zero `svd`/`eigh`/`pinv`/`torch.compile`, and zero new `Recipe` fields.

Opt-in research/production family (`preset="axiom"`): keeps `DEFAULT_RECIPE = "unified_v12"` unchanged and carries `default_adoption: false`; Forge calibration acceptance remains BLOCKED under `configs/forge/calibration/criteria-v1.json`.

Headline RTX A6000 results (`reports/axiom/axiom-study.md`): 18/18 (100%) sweep on `r3-tier3-long-horizon-holdout-v1` (including all three 14k continuations), 34.86 ms/step & 805.8 MiB peak alloc (`7.307 J/step` matched idle NVML energy, -29.8% below `unified-v14` and 13.1x below `rhbi`) on `dcgan_performance_r256`, 2/2 `bytegan_stretch` (`rms_bit_error=0.00471`, 9.3x lower than `unified-v14`), 2/2 `t3_causal_isolation_stretch` (`core_min_eigen_ratio=0.5447`), 3/3 `t4_imbalance_nash_stretch`, 5/5 `t3-shift-recovery-diagnostic-v1`, 5/7 `t4-strange-architectures-v1`, and 9/9 Four-Laws adversarial stress controls.

Matched NVIDIA L4 diagnostic results (`four-laws-adherence-v1`, protocol seed 0): 2/2 ByteGAN PASS at repository-best J-to-PASS (`2.77 kJ` on `bytegan_hypercube8`, 1.93x lower than `unified-v13` and 2.58x lower than `unified-v14`; `3.67 kJ` on `bytegan_bigan_dictionary`, 2.92x lower than `unified-v13` and 3.88x lower than `unified-v14`), #1 lowest J-to-PASS on `fl_law42_swap_deep_critic_16l` (`0.84 kJ`), #1 lowest 9-probe NVML total energy across full 4-Law families (`26.84 kJ`), and #1 best margin on `fl_law44_highd_sparse_prior_and_shock` (`-1.66`).

Promoted `axiom-v5` RTX A6000 results (`876222b5dde8`): **45 PASS / 2 FAIL** on the 59-test active full suite (**102/115** counted view requirements, **Screening Tier 2** under Rev-9 comparison projection, passing `img_blobs4`, `vector_spiral`, `model_ddgan_gaussian_chain`, `interp_sparse_arc`, `interp_img_patch_shift`, `interp_saddle_barycentric`, `grid100_mlp16`, and `grid100_res16_scaled_tanh`), `34.39 ms/step` / `877.9 MiB` solo DCGAN `r256` (`32.84 ms/step`, `8.254 J/step`, `3,511.6 J` `grid100` J-to-PASS in uncontended NVML benchmark `reports/forge/studies/rtx-a6000-v14-v15-axiom-v5-energy-benchmark.json`), and `15/16` `r4-occam-ablation-v1`. Honest remaining numerical failures on `axiom-v5`: `model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain` (gating `model_ae_ddgan_bimodal_chain`) and `model_ddgan_bimodal_chain` in Tier 2, plus separate multi-view failures on `bytegan_bigan_dictionary`, `grid100_res16_tanh`, `ring_hold`, `ring_extension`, and `zero_tanh_rail_escape` (`axiom-v4` historical audit preserved in `reports/axiom/axiom-v4-failure-analysis.md`).

law1.mechanism: Mass-conserving Laguerre-Pythagorean prototype atlas + 4-step LTV coalescence + central-offset pullback isometry + charts-first atomic bijection
law1.how_it_works: Implements a GPU-resident mass-conserving Laguerre quantizer (`sum(w_fake_ema) == 1` across teleportation), 4-step transitive-closure Pythagorean LTV coalescence (`cs <= 10.0`), unbiased `v_cprev` quantizer variance, prime-wrapping-free Box-Muller central-offset pullback covariance isometry (`D <= 64`), and charts-first GPU-vectorized atomic bijection (`particlegan/_axiom/prior.py`, `particlegan/_axiom/transport.py`). Delivers 2/2 ByteGAN PASS (`rms_bit_error=0.00471` on A6000, `2.77 kJ` / `3.67 kJ` J-to-PASS on L4 — 1.93x-3.88x lower energy than `unified-v13`/`v14`), 3/3 100-mode grids + 3/3 14k continuations (`18/18` Tier-3 holdout sweep), and 2.65x-3.0x better margin than `unified-v12..v14` on `fl_law1_noisy_atomic_codebook`.
law1.known_limits: Still fails `img_blobs4` (2/4 modes), `vector_spiral` (`sw1=0.1263`), continuous manifold interpolation (`interp_saddle_barycentric`, `interp_sparse_arc` sustained suffix; `interp_img_patch_shift` raw receipt `FAIL` was audited as a CUDA FP32 `0.99999994 < 1.0` scorer bug in `reports/axiom/axiom-v4-failure-analysis.md`), and the two Law-1 falsification probes (`fl_law1_aniso_unequal_modes` scalar-trace Law 1A gap, `fl_law1_noisy_atomic_codebook` binary-gate Law 1B gap).

law2.mechanism: Compute-regime-dispatched exact RoR / Weyl-phase sub-batch fwAD R1+R2 + detached-EMA adaptive scaling + mu_D=0.005 floor + zero-mean gauge
law2.how_it_works: Dispatches exact RoR on low-D MLPs, EmulatedLinear MXFP8/NVFP4, and fwAD-unsupported ops, and clock-free Weyl-phase sub-batch `b_reg = max(2, B // 4)` interleaved R1+R2 dense-Rademacher `fwAD` with `BN.eval()` dual-BF16 hooks on Conv2d/high-D (`particlegan/_axiom/critic.py`, `particlegan/_axiom/loss.py`), paired with detached-EMA adaptive linear-in-`s_hat` scaling (zero Jensen bias), `mu_D=0.005` floor, log-space clamped `ema_data_scale`, and swap-invariant zero-mean gauge. Passes `fl_law2_pure_adversarial_codim1` (`0.74 kJ` L4), 3/3 precision (`fp32`/`mxfp8`/`nvfp4`), and cuts idle A6000 `dcgan_performance_r256` to `34.86 ms/step`, `805.8 MiB`, `7.307 J/step` (-29.8% energy vs `unified-v14`).
law2.known_limits: Fails `fl_law2_groupnorm_and_vit_sprites` (`-4.36` on L4) under GroupNorm + ViT attention critics, and `axiom-v4` enforces unscaled `||grad_x D||_2 <= kappa` rather than whitened-coordinate `s_data ||grad_x D||_2 <= kappa` (Law 2 x 4.4 amendment).

law3.mechanism: Conformal k=3 Voronoi horizons + dead-zone-free orphan macro-transport (3A) + zero-eigh Pade-(1,1) Halley conditional fiber operator bank (3B)
law3.how_it_works: Law 3A couples `(1 - g_conn)`-gated valley-capped `k=3` Voronoi conformal horizons with dead-zone-free orphan macro-transport (`1.35 rho` onset) and `shock_mu_ratio=0.35` / `cvx_mu_gain=0.58` thermal calibration (`particlegan/_axiom/transport.py`), scoring repository-best `2/2` `t3_causal_isolation_stretch` (`core_min_eigen_ratio=0.5447`, `cov_err=0.2376`). Law 3B replaces `eigh` with analytic `2x2` + 7-step RMS-scaled Pade-(1,1) Halley `sym_eigensplit_zero_eigh` and 16-step coupled NS `_sym_inv_sqrt` plus detach-surviving `_capture_ring` lookup.
law3.known_limits: Still fails `model_ddgan_gaussian_chain` and `model_ae_ddgan_gaussian_chain` (which gate the two bimodal DDGAN chains in `discriminator_stability`), fails `fl_law3_highd_orphan_d32` (`-1.00` on L4 due to rank-8 single-sketch covariance bias), and skips ambient transport above `dim > 1024`.

law4.mechanism: IEEE-754 mantissa-exponent degree-0 norm + deadband-free step-cosine & spectral-split Tikhonov NS with exact 4D 1x1 Conv2d parity + stratified p95 trust + 1-sync 2x2 KKT direction_blend
law4.how_it_works: Normalizes updates via IEEE-754 mantissa-exponent degree-0 scaling, tracks outlier-robust Winsorized log-RMS scale + deadband-free step-cosine settling, applies role-agnostic bounded spectral-split FP32 Tikhonov NS (`min(sqrt(m), 2*sqrt(r_eff))`, zero permanent `s_eq` inside 2D NS) with exact 4D `1x1` ungrouped Conv2d == 2D Linear parity and 0 NS on healthy spatial Conv2d, fuses elementwise work into a 3-kernel contiguous `foreach` path, and enforces iterative stratified p95 pushforward trust plus 1-sync closed-form 2x2 KKT `direction_blend` (`particlegan/_axiom/optimizer.py`). Passes 3/3 `t4_imbalance_nash_stretch`, 5/5 `t3-shift-recovery-diagnostic-v1`, 9/9 Four-Laws adversarial stress controls, #1 lowest L4 J-to-PASS on `fl_law42_swap_deep_critic_16l` (`0.84 kJ`), #1 best L4 margin on `fl_law44_highd_sparse_prior_and_shock` (`-1.66`), and `fl_law42_deep_resbn_and_conv1x1` PASS on RTX A6000.
law4.known_limits: Misses the 5-check sustained window on `fl_law42_deep_resbn_and_conv1x1` on NVIDIA L4 (`min_margin=+0.000`, first pass `2.09 kJ`), nearly passes `fl_law41_trust_rare1pct_tanh` (`-0.05` L4, first pass `1.61 kJ`; global `p95` backtracking throttles `_ema_func_gain`), and fails `grid100_mlp16` (terminal pass, missed suffix), `grid100_res16_tanh` (`cov_trace_bias=-0.1184`), and `fl_law44_highd_sparse_prior_and_shock` (`-1.66`).

law5.mechanism: Zero-eigh Pade-(1,1) Halley conditional fiber deconfounding (5C/3B); partial-observation injectivity (5A) and intrinsic feature-space transport (5B) not yet implemented
law5.how_it_works: Partially addresses provisional Law 5 via its conditional fiber operator bank (Law 5C, unifying Law 3B) using analytic 2x2 and 7-step RMS-scaled Pade-(1,1) Halley operator matching plus a detach-surviving capture ring (`particlegan/_axiom/transport.py`, `particlegan/_axiom/loss.py`). Assumes complete uncorrupted Euclidean observations and disables transport above raw ambient `dim > 1024` rather than evaluating discrepancies in a mask-consistent or learned intrinsic feature geometry.
law5.known_limits: Fails partial 10%-masked `R^512` observation recovery (`fl_law44_highd_sparse_prior_and_shock`, where unmasked finite-batch coupling faces independent-mask expected-L2^2 shrinkage `X* = p E[Y]` and `HighDRMSNormCritic` erases observation scale), skips transport on `32x32x3` RGB sprites (`fl_law2_groupnorm_and_vit_sprites`), and lacks public mask-aware MisGAN adapters for the 12 blocked Tier-4 placeholders.
